name: MorphGate custom rules
description: MorphGate (Pro and above), variant ONLY for zones with NO rate limiting rule protecting /__mg/: additionally skips http_ratelimit. Skipping http_ratelimit disables every rate limiting rule for /__mg/*, including a /__mg/ flood rule. Default: waf-skip.mg.json. Template: adapters/cloudflare/README.md.

rules.description: MorphGate: /__mg/* skips SBFM, rate limiting rules, Browser Integrity Check and Security Level. Only for zones without a /__mg/ flood rate limiting rule.
